items.title: Radar issue delaying flights at Chicago O’Hare airport
items.text: FAA radar issue delays flights into Chicago O’Hare; repairs expected to last into Wednesday, with about 12% of flights affected.

items.title: Human Metabolic Chamber inaugurated at CMC in Vellore
items.text: The Human Metabolic Chamber is a room-sized calorimeter that measures oxygen consumption and carbon dioxide production while a volunteer lives, eats, and sleeps inside for 24 hours or longer

items.title: Under Nishant’s leadership, the future of the party remains bright for next 30 years, says Sanjay Jha
items.text: Mr. Jha also said that former Chief Minister Nitish Kumar has transformed Bihar’s image and identity over the past two decades.

items.title: PNGRB rewrites gas pipeline rules; proposes 14% returns to developers, shifts volume risk
items.text: The regulator said the existing bidding framework had threatened the financial viability of projects when actual gas flows fell short of projections
